featured.title: THE GLORY OF GOD
featured.speaker: Pastor Evelyn Joshua Sermon
featured.summaryHtml:
What if the trials you are trying to escape are not a reason to run from God, but an invitation to trust Him more?

Pastor Evelyn Joshua reminds us in her sermon, “The Glory of God,” that God remains faithful even when our circumstances change. His goodness does not depend on our timelines or situations.

Drawing from James 1:17 and Revelation 4:11, she points us back to God as the source of every good and perfect gift and the One worthy of all glory.

What has God done in your life that reminds you He can never fail?

Watch this powerful message and be reminded to hold on to God, trust His faithfulness, and give Him the glory.
